title: Implement audit root signature generation
summary: Add deterministic signing and verification for audit-root-attestation.v1 payloads so provenance claims can be verified end-to-end without overclaiming public transparency.
expectedFailureModes: Signatures are generated but the signature metadata format is underspecified and breaks across versions.
Verification accepts malformed payloads or incorrect subjects, undermining the trust boundary.
Docs overclaim public verifiability when keys are still local-only and not rotated.
nextAction: Choose the signing identity and key format, implement signing + verification, and record the security review notes before integration.
